author: Neubert, M., Ligeti, Z., and Nir, Y.
title: The Subleading Isgur-Wise Form Factor $\chi_3(v\cdot v')$ to Order $\alpha_s$ in QCD Sum Rules
abstract: We calculate the contributions arising at order $\alpha_s$ in the QCD sum rule for the spin-symmetry violating universal function $\chi_3(v\cdot v')$, which appears at order $1/m_Q$ in the heavy quark expansion of meson form factors. In particular, we derive the two-loop perturbative contribution to the sum rule. Over the kinematic range accessible in $B\to D^{(*)}\ell\,\nu$ decays, we find that $\chi_3(v\cdot v')$ does not exceed the level of $\sim 1\%$, indicating that power corrections induced by the chromo-magnetic operator in the heavy quark expansion are small.

data.note: Complete order-$\alpha_s$ QCD sum rule for $\chi_3(y)$, including the two-loop perturbative contribution and the renormalization of the spin-symmetry-violating decay constant $G_2(\mu)$. The result is shown only in Figs. 2-3: over the kinematic range accessible in $B\to D^{(*)}\ell\nu$ decays $\chi_3(y)$ does not exceed the level of $\sim 1\%$, with a relative uncertainty of about $\pm 25\%$ dominated by the continuum threshold. No tabulated values are published, so the channel is empty; $\chi_3(1)=0$ follows from Luke's theorem and is not a measurement of this paper.
